stimuli.title: Seven people live on different floors of a seven-storey building. Floor 1 is the bottom floor, and floor 7 is the top floor.
stimuli.body:
Clues:
1. In the stated ordering, Deepa comes before Lakshya, and Lakshya comes before Eshan.
2. Zara is exactly 2 positions above Hemanth.
3. Zara is exactly 3 positions above Isha.
4. Lakshya is exactly 2 positions above Deepa.
5. Lakshya is at floor 6.

questions.stem: Given the inequality chain P ≥ V ≤ S ≥ T > R, decide which conclusions follow. I: P < V. II: P ≥ V.
options: Both conclusions I and II follow
Either conclusion I or II follows
questions.explanation: Exhaustive valid-order checking confirms: I is not necessarily true and II is always true.

options: Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.stem: Statements: Some bakers are teachers. All teachers are farmers. Conclusions: I. Some bakers are farmers. II. All bakers are farmers. Which conclusion follows?
options: Both conclusions I and II follow
Either conclusion I or II follows
questions.explanation: Some A–B members must be C; not all A need be C.

questions.stem: Statements: No artists are runners. Some runners are drivers. Conclusions: I. Some drivers are not artists. II. No drivers are artists. Which conclusion follows?
options: Both conclusions I and II follow
Either conclusion I or II follows
questions.explanation: The B∩C members are outside A; other C members remain unrestricted.

questions.stem: Statements: All teachers are drivers. No drivers are singers. Conclusions: I. No teachers are singers. II. Some teachers are singers. Which conclusion follows?
options: Both conclusions I and II follow
Either conclusion I or II follows
questions.explanation: A is contained in B, while B and C are disjoint.

questions.stem: Statements: Some painters are coders. No coders are artists. Conclusions: I. Some painters are not artists. II. All painters are artists. Which conclusion follows?
options: Both conclusions I and II follow
Either conclusion I or II follows
questions.explanation: The A∩B members cannot be C.

questions.stem: Statements: Some singers are workers. Some workers are teachers. Conclusions: I. Some singers are teachers. II. Some workers are singers. Which conclusion follows?
options: Both conclusions I and II follow
Either conclusion I or II follows
questions.explanation: The two Some overlaps need not coincide; Some A are B converts to Some B are A.

questions.stem: Ritu walks 45 km north, then 36 km east, then 9 km south and finally 9 km west. What is her shortest distance from the starting point?

questions.stem: Kiran moves 9 km north, 54 km east, 27 km south and 9 km west. In which direction is Kiran from the start?

questions.stem: A cyclist travels 81 km north, 36 km east, 45 km south and 9 km west. What total distance did the cyclist travel?
questions.explanation: Total path length = 81+36+45+9=171 km (not displacement).

questions.stem: Compare x and y. Equation I: x² + 0x − 1 = 0. Equation II: y² − 5y + 4 = 0. Which option is always correct?

questions.stem: Compare x and y. Equation I: x² − 5x + 4 = 0. Equation II: y² + 0y − 1 = 0. Which option is always correct?

questions.stem: Compare x and y. Equation I: x² + 5x + 6 = 0. Equation II: y² − 3y + 2 = 0. Which option is always correct?
